biography: Hey..! I am Md. Muhaiminul Islam. But you can also call me 'Jamee'! I am a highly motivated and dedicated researcher with a lifelong passion for Machine Learning & Deep Learning, specializing in Edge AI, Computer Vision, Robotics, and Cyber-Physical Systems. I pursued my B.Sc. (Engg.) in Electronics and Telecommunication Engineering from Rajshahi University of Engineering & Technology (RUET), one of Bangladesh’s top engineering universities, graduating in 2025. **My current goal is to pursue a Ph.D. starting in Fall 2027, focusing on Edge AI, Computer Vision, Multimodal Learning, and Intelligent Robotic Systems, with the aim of developing efficient, robust, and real-world deployable AI systems.** During my undergraduate years, I served as an undergraduate research assistant for 3 years in the ETE Lab of RUET. Beyond my research experience, I have also worked as an Embedded System Engineer at two multinational companies for 1.5 years. Over the years, I have secured more than 30 awards in Robotics, Programming, Olympiads, and Hackathons at both national and international levels, including the Technical Award Medalist at the 22nd International Robot Olympiad 2020 and Champion at the CISCO IoT Hackathon 2018. I have also successfully completed over 25 innovative, real-world projects in the domains of IoT, Computer Vision, Robotics, and Machine Learning. Moreover, I have published six research papers in reputed IEEE conferences and am currently working on three additional journal manuscripts that are in preparation.

I am currently conducting research on a systematic benchmark of Edge AI inference frameworks for resource-constrained autonomous mobile robot platforms. Previously, I conducted research on a multimodal robotic framework for real-time waste detection and categorization, with a focus on developing robust perception and classification capabilities for autonomous waste management robots. I have also worked on simultaneous localization and mapping (SLAM) for robotic vision and path planning. My broader interests include vision-language models, autonomous intelligent systems, and natural language processing.

My vision is to develop innovative technologies and advance research in areas such as Smart Agriculture, Healthcare, Environmental Sustainability, and Disaster Management to create a global impact through research, teaching, and leadership. I am always open to discussions, whether it's about robotics, AI research collaboration, or just a good cup of coffee!
